correctness.rationale: Under the cyclic encoding R=F2[z,z^-1]/(z^n-1), the exact update block is [[z+z^-1,1],[1,z^3+z^-3]] and determinant z^-4 Phi_5(z)^2. For n coprime to five determinant is a unit. Otherwise Phi_5 occurs to multiplicity e=2^nu2(n). At this factor the characteristic polynomial has two simple roots 0 and 1, which lift to complementary rank-one local summands; on the zero summand the eigenvalue is unit*Phi_5². Multiplication by Phi_5^(2t) has kernel degree 4min(2t,e); this gives the rank, primary Jordan blocks and eventual-periodic counts, not an extrapolation. Independent GF2 bit-vector matrices constructed from labelled graph edges checked all t=0..7 for every 7<=n<=50 (352 exact rank checks) plus all 44 fixed dimensions, agreeing with det(B+I)=z^-4(z+1)^4Phi_5. The general proof uses CRT/local factorization; the bounded checks do not prove it.
